labels.budgetBlock: New engagements stop at the allowance

tooltips.overagePolicy: Allow overage bills additional engagements. Block at allowance pauses new AI work when consumed credits plus active reservations reach the monthly allowance; already authorized engagements finish normally. With Block and zero included credits, AI is paused immediately.
tooltips.billingModel: The commercial model agreed with this tenant for this period. Blank shows configuration required in AI Usage. Model and monthly allowance changes should begin at a month boundary.
tooltips.name: Optional label. Left empty = auto "YYYY-MM-DD → YYYY-MM-DD|∞".
tooltips.effectiveFrom: First calendar day (app timezone) this rate card applies to conversation-days.
tooltips.effectiveTo: Last calendar day inclusive. Leave empty for the open-ended current agreement. Creating a new open period auto-closes the previous open one the day before.
tooltips.currency: Deal currency for unit prices below (Administration → Currency). Empty = system default.
tooltips.packUnitPrice: Pack model: price per pack of up to N agent runs, per conversation or opportunity and per day. Empty = platform default (1.99).
tooltips.packSize: Pack model: maximum number of agent runs per pack. Each run counts once, regardless of the number of LLM calls or tokens. Empty = 4.
tooltips.extraBasePrice: Extra model: fixed charge per conversation or opportunity with agent runs that day. Empty = 0.99.
tooltips.extraUnitPrice: Extra model: price per additional agent run. Applies to customer message runs above the base allowance and to every mention or automation run (@mention, follow-up or scheduled message). Empty = 0.49.
tooltips.extraIncludedTurns: Extra model: number of customer message runs included in the base charge per conversation and day. Mention or automation runs are billed separately. Empty = 4.
tooltips.planIncludedUsage: Monthly plan allowance, measured in packs for the pack model and conversations or opportunities handled for the extra model. 0 = no allowance. Use a full-month report range to apply the allowance in chronological order.
tooltips.creditUnitPrice: Credit model: price per credit. Each agent run consumes 1 credit, regardless of the number of LLM calls or tokens. Applies to runs triggered by customer messages, @mentions, follow-ups or scheduled messages. Empty = 0.49.
tooltips.planIncludedCredits: Credits included per calendar month. Each agent engagement consumes 1 credit. Allow overage bills additional credits at the Credit Unit Price; Block at allowance pauses new AI work when consumed and reserved credits reach this limit. Zero means no included credits (and pauses AI immediately when blocking). Use a full-month report range.
